title: The piste map
notes: Block R1 (reshoot). A Photo Mode camera over the run fan with the hub's piste map on (the check box at the top of the hub's Runs view, Runs open tile at 3125, 300; it draws while the hub is open). photoMode.setOverlayHidden stays false and the overlay op is not used: both hide the piste map. From the west below the bowl, looking east up the runs at Photo Mode Time of Day 13. Take 5: 28 mm, a 7.5 s crane up and in. Take 6: 35 mm, closer, the same direction. The still r1-07-se.jpg shows the green and black run outlines thin at this distance and the run names not readable. State: bridgetrailer1j after the 09 / 09b / 08 takes, sim about 15:1x on 2029-01-08, speed 1. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60).

blockC1c.note: The block C1c setup (game camera), kept for reference: its best take is the one to compare against.
blockC1c.notes: Normal game camera over the run fan with the hub's piste map on (the check box at the top of the hub's Runs view, opened with the Runs open tile at 3125, 300; it draws while the hub is open, on any hub view). photoMode.setOverlayHidden and the bridge's overlay op must be off: both hide the piste map (measured: the run outlines vanish while the overlay is hidden). The six 'Powerline Not Connected - Low' icons on the lift bases were deleted before shot 08 (sim paused, one batch, 60 frames, status check); no other icon was touched. The UI view is hidden with the ui step. Camera from west of the bowl looking east, pivot (3600, 1200, -2320): a crane down and in from zoom 1350, tilt 36, yaw 90 to zoom 1150, tilt 31, yaw 100. The runs fan out up the bowl with the lift lines between them, the base area at the bottom, the ridge at the top. The recorded frame reads more top-down and wider than a photo still from the same camera (the slope rises toward the view). Sim 15:04 to 15:13, speed 1. Take 3: pivot (3540, 1160, -2330), zoom 1550 to 1300, tilt 47 to 42, yaw 90 to 100 (closer to top-down, the ridge cut). Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60). rec.mjs dedupe (mpdecimate) dropped real frames in the move (holds of 4 and 5), so the -x60.mp4 was made with shoot/dd.cjs at a luma threshold of 0.15.
